description: Use this when you need to know which inboxes exist on the signed-in account, for example to pick an inbox_id before sending or reading mail, or to tell the user their address. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: status (optional; active or paused; omit to list every inbox). Returns {data:[{id, username, email, display_name, created_at, require_sender_auth, status, paused_at}]}.

status.description: Optional filter. active or paused. Omit to list every inbox.

name: cooper_list_inboxes
title: List inboxes
